# Axlemark Shopify theme

> Axlemark is a Shopify theme for large-catalog auto parts, tech, electronics and IT accessories stores, designed like a workshop manual and parts catalog. It has a built-in vehicle and device product finder with a fit check on product pages, so stores do not need a finder app. Two presets: "Axlemark" for auto parts (Make / Model / Year) and "Signal" for tech accessories (Brand / Device). Current version: 2.0.0 (2026-10-22). One-time price on the Shopify Theme Store: USD 360.

## Key facts

- Design point of view (2.0.0): a workshop manual / parts counter. Drafting-paper backgrounds, hairline rules, chapter-numbered section headings (§ 01), numbered figures (FIG. 01), part numbers, prices and specs in a mono font, dotted-leader spec rows and fit verdicts shown as stamps, used the same way on every template.
- Catalog plates (product cards): part number strip with a status dot, image in a figure frame with corner ticks and a FIG number, condensed title, mono price, square Add button. Theme settings > Catalog style > Product card style: Catalog plate or Minimal.
- Parts table view: collections and search switch between Grid and Table (part no., product, fit / status, stock, price, quantity + Add per row). The shopper's choice is remembered on their device. Section settings: Default view and Show grid / table switch.
- Part number match: a search that matches a variant SKU exactly pins that part above the results with an add-to-cart button (setting: Highlight exact part number matches).
- Spec-sheet product page: catalog path line, big part number that follows the selected variant, fitment stamp, specs from a product metafield (default custom.specs) as dotted-leader rows plus the variant's options, weight and barcode, buying blocks grouped in a "parts slip", numbered gallery thumbnails with FIG captions.
- Parts-list cart: cart drawer and cart page as numbered lines with a fit check per line and a counter receipt that shows the saved vehicle or device as a stamp.
- Catalog style settings: card style, drafting grid, corner ticks, FIG numbers, numbered section headings, line art colour; Typography > Technical type sets the mono font.
- Product finder: 1 to 3 cascading levels (Year / Make / Model, Brand / Device, Brand / Series / Printer model, or tire size). Products match by product tags; finder data comes from section blocks or a JSON file in Shopify Content > Files. No app needed.
- Saved vehicle or device in the header, a finder results collection template, and a Fitment check block on product pages ("Fits your ...", "Universal fit", "Not confirmed"). Fit is never claimed without a matching tag.
- Size finder: dropdowns (for example tire width / profile / rim) built from product tags such as tyre-205-55-r16.
- Shop-by-part vehicle diagram (exploded view): hatchback, sedan, SUV and pickup line art with exterior and interior hotspots as numbered callouts, plus a parts index with the same numbers.
- Split hero with finder card, popular links, part-number search examples and category tiles or the vehicle diagram.
- Two header layouts, including a Categories button that opens a catalog mega menu with category images, plus a second-row link bar.
- Predictive search with product thumbnails, highlighted matches, vendor and price.
- Collection spotlight with tag filter chips; brand rails, brand wall and an A-Z brand directory page set as a catalog index. Buying guides are numbered chapters with a numbered table of contents; the FAQ is numbered Q.01, Q.02.
- Product cards: quick add, swatches, ratings, status badges from tags, unit label, shipping notes, product page button, optional incl./excl. tax label and switch.
- Product page: variant swatches, combined listings, accelerated checkout, subscriptions, gift card recipient form, pickup availability, specifications table from metafields, collapsible tabs, complementary products, share.
- Business buyers: quick order page (order many parts by SKU or barcode) and a trade account application page.
- Buying guides: "Products in this guide" from an article metafield or matching collection tag, plus related posts.
- SEO: JSON-LD for Organization or store type, WebSite with SearchAction, BreadcrumbList, Product/ProductGroup, Article, and FAQPage from the FAQ section; canonical, Open Graph and X (Twitter) tags.
- Performance and accessibility: no frameworks or external scripts, about 35 KB gzip of shared theme CSS and JavaScript on the home page, keyboard-accessible menus and drawers.
- 16 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese (Portugal), Danish, Swedish, Polish, Czech, Finnish, Norwegian Bokmal, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese. Five color schemes and heading, body and mono font pickers. Presets: Axlemark (workshop grey #F2F3F5, graphite ink, safety orange, Barlow Condensed / IBM Plex Sans / IBM Plex Mono, square corners) and Signal (light datasheet #F4F7F9 with dark schematic bands #0B1622, cyan line art, electric lime, Space Grotesk / Instrument Sans / Geist Mono, 4px corners).
